# Frontier26 stage-open review request(전선26 단계 개방 검토 요청)

Role(역할): external second opinion(외부 2차 의견). Do not create runtime authority(런타임 권위), baseline(기준선), promotion(승격), live readiness(실거래 준비), or Goal Achieve(목표 달성).

Current truth(현재 진실): Frontier25(전선25) is closed as preserved_clue + negative_memory(보존 단서+부정 기억). F25B found non-repeat scout rows(비반복 탐색 행) but no seed/handoff(씨앗/인계 없음): density/scout/seed/handoff(빈도/탐색/씨앗/인계) = 24/17/0/0; F24B top10 overlap(F24B 상위10 중복) = 0. Best F25B forward-read row `f25b_0022`: validation PF/density/DD(검증 수익 팩터/빈도/손실폭) 1.23272 / 5.60656/day / 20.1588%; OOS PF/density/DD(표본외 수익 팩터/빈도/손실폭) 1.24574 / 6.16031/day / 14.2862%. Closest seed-gap row `f25b_0001`: forward min PF(전방 최소 수익 팩터) 1.21646 but forward max DD(전방 최대 손실폭) 19.7857%, above the 18% seed DD cap(씨앗 손실폭 상한 초과).

F25 negative memory(전선25 부정 기억): DD-headroom-first bridge archetype preselection(손실폭 여유 우선 연결 원형 사전 선택) did not break the seed tradeoff(씨앗 상충). F25C rejected validation/OOS-targeted capped filter repair(검증/표본외 표적 상한 필터 수리) because it would data-mine forward bottlenecks(전방 병목 데이터마이닝 위험).

Proposed Frontier26(제안 전선26): `stage_frontier_26__joint_micro_satisfaction_before_bridge_union_onnx_scout`.

Hypothesis(가설): F25 failed because union-level selection allowed components that were not individually joint-satisfactory. Before same-side OR-union(같은 방향 OR 합집합), require each micro pocket(미세 구간) to satisfy train-only joint PF+DD+shape conditions(학습 전용 수익 팩터+손실폭+거래형태 동시 조건). Only then build pair/triple unions(쌍/삼중 합집합). This changes pre-union component quality(합집합 전 구성 품질), not post-union repair(합집합 후 수리).

Proposed F26B proxy(제안 전선26B 프록시): rebuild F24/F25 micro pockets from existing scripts; filter components on train only: per-micro train PF >= 1.18, train DD <= 14%, train density 2-6/day, equity trend R2 >= 0.70, max loss streak <= 18, adverse loss p10 not worse than source median; then same-side pair/triple OR-union with density 5-10/day, train PF >= 1.10, bridge train DD <= 16%, overlap <= 0.40, min unique density contribution >= 0.40. Rank using train-only joint_micro_satisfaction_score(학습 전용 미세 구간 합동 충족 점수). Validation/OOS are read-only flags(검증/표본외 읽기 전용).

Unchanged gates(유지 게이트): scout PF>=1.10, density 5-10/day, max forward DD<=25%; seed PF>=1.20 and DD<=18%; handoff PF>=1.50 and DD<=12% with smoothness proxy(매끄러움 프록시). No ONNX/MT5/runtime probe(ONNX/MT5/런타임 탐침) until handoff_candidate_rows > 0.

Review questions(검토 질문):
1. verdict(판정): accepted/rejected/needs_local_verification(수용/거절/로컬 검증 필요)?
2. Is this a valid new hypothesis(새 가설) versus repeating F25?
3. Which locks(잠금) must F26A write before proxy?
4. What smallest F26B proxy(가장 작은 전선26B 프록시) should be run?
5. What stop condition(중지 조건) should close it as negative or invalid?
